# Khadeeja Designs
> A boutique Aari embroidery studio in Trichy (Tiruchirappalli), Tamil Nadu, creating handcrafted bridal blouse designs and custom embroidery for customers across India.

## Key facts
- Business: Khadeeja Designs
- Location: 17 East Sayakara Lane, Jaffersha Street, Tiruchirappalli (also written Trichy, Tiruchchirappalli, Tiruchi) 620008, Tamil Nadu, India; studio visits by appointment
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 86674 54391
- Email: contact@khadeejadesigns.in
- Hours: 10 am to 7 pm, Monday to Saturday; Sunday by appointment
- Enquiries: response within 6 hours during studio hours
- Ordering: send your saree photo and event date, receive a written quote (embroidery price, courier charge, delivery date), pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse or saree to the studio, pay the balance when the work is finished, then receive it back by tracked courier
- Timeline: about 14–21 days of embroidery after the blouse and advance arrive; book bridal work 4–6 weeks before the wedding
- Policies: advance is refundable only before work starts; free rework of agreed-design issues reported within 7 days of delivery; no change-of-mind returns (https://khadeejadesigns.in/policies/)
- Prices: 7 listed designs from ₹1,999 to ₹8,499 for hand Aari embroidery on a blouse the customer supplies. Light work from ₹1,999; medium ₹4,499–₹4,999; heavy bridal ₹6,499–₹8,499. The blouse itself is not included. Delivery within Trichy is free; courier to other places is quoted separately
- Services: bridal and custom Aari embroidery for blouses and sarees, with designs tailored to the garment and occasion
- Social: https://instagram.com/khadeeja.designs
